_comment: Scene-anchored keyframe via img2img (ComfyUI API format, CORE NODES ONLY — no custom nodes, no extra models). For shots WITHOUT a character: starts from the scene reference image (the style-consistent CogView scene base, uploaded to input/) and partially redraws it at {{DENOISE}} so the background layout/colors stay consistent with the scene across shots. Enable via config/pipeline.yaml keyframe.use_scene_ref=true (default off). Placeholders injected by the pipeline: {{CKPT}} {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{SEED}} {{DENOISE}} {{CONTROL_IMAGE}}(scene ref filename in ComfyUI input/). Output size follows the reference image's size, so make scene refs the same vertical aspect as keyframes. DENOISE 0.5-0.7: lower=stick closer to the scene ref (more consistent), higher=more freedom for the shot's action.
